result.description:
Located in the heart of Maitland, NSW 2320. The Whistler has become a vibrant destination known for its modern Australian menu, curated cocktails, and relaxed yet sophisticated atmosphere for Breakfast, lunch, and Dinner. The venue blends casual dining with elevated flair, offering everything from hearty brunches and share plates to evening gatherings that capture the essence of contemporary hospitality.

The Whistler is currently seeking skilled Cooks and Chefs to join its culinary team on a full-time basis. With competitive salaries ranging from AUD 75k to 85k per annum, depending on experience, this opportunity offers professionals the chance to contribute to a venue that values creativity, teamwork, and consistent quality.

Scope of the Work:
- Overseeing daily kitchen operations, including staff delegation, stock rotation, and maintaining accurate records.
- Preparing and cooking a variety of dishes, either regularly or for special functions and events.
- Managing production schedules and staff requirements to ensure timely service delivery.
- Estimating food supply needs, calculating costs for ingredients, and managing orders accordingly.
- Inspecting supplies, equipment, and work areas to ensure adherence to established quality standards.
- Analysing recipes and advising prices to menu items based on food, labour, and overhead costs.
- Working closely with team members to execute established recipes and menus with consistency and precision, ensuring alignment with seasonal availability and anticipated customer volume.
- Demonstrating new cooking techniques and introducing equipment to staff for continual culinary improvement.
- Oversee workstation readiness by ensuring mise en place is complete, equipment is functional, and kitchen operations are primed for service efficiency and food quality standards.
- Prepare and cook dishes in strict compliance with food safety and health regulations, ensuring the highest quality and hygiene standards are maintained.
-Assist in onboarding, training, and supervising new team members, providing guidance and fostering a collaborative, efficient work environment.
- Monitoring and enforcing sanitation practices to ensure compliance with health and safety regulations, including Occupational Health and Safety (WHS) and HACCP.

To be considered for this role, you should:
- Be willing to relocate if you are interstate or in other cities.
- Preferably have Certificates III & IV in Commercial Cookery
- Be available on both days at weekends and be able to work split shifts.
- Have at least 2- 3 years of work experience as a Cook/Chef.
- Ability to work in a team.
- Exceptional communication skills.

What you’ll get in return:
- Opportunities for Career Progression
- Be Part of a Historic, Community-Focused Venue
- Great work environment

How to join the team:
Please submit an online application to join our diverse, compassionate and dedicated team for a rewarding career. Only successful applicants will be contacted.

Candidates must hold Australian or NZ Citizenship or the capacity to work in Australia permanently. A temporary visa holder may only be employed if no suitable permanent resident or citizen of Australia has been identified for this position following suitable labour market testing.
result.title: Cooks and Chefs [Nulkaba Projects Pty Ltd  t/a The Whistler]

result.description:
Since 1981, Shadbolt Group has grown to become a leading cost-effective engineering solutions provider. We are proud of our professional performance on each and every project. Our aim is to build long term relationships with our clients based on trust, accountability and integrity. It is our dedication to quality that gives our clients a competitive advantage.

This goes hand in hand with our diligence and engineering excellence. From pipework projects to tank manufacturing, structural works, machine building or site work. Shadbolt Group is committed to providing prompt and precise delivery from our highly trained team of experts. The requirements of each client are always the focus of everything we do.

We are seeking qualified Pressure Welders to join our growing professional team. We seek reliable, team-oriented individuals with high integrity who will positively contribute to the company's success. We offer short-term contracts with above-award pay rates fully guaranteed under current workplace regulations.
Position available across our site and work locations in NSW, SA, WA and VIC.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read and interpret project plans, engineering drawings, blueprints and other written instructions and diagrams to determine and perform appropriate welding techniques for the task at hand
Set up equipment and weld parts, using appropriate pressure welding equipment and methods
Examine welds for width of bead, penetration and precision, and performs necessary repairs or reworks
Weld and repair pressure vessels and pipes to relevant high-quality standards and ensure conformance with standard specifications
Fabricate metal components in accordance with supplied drawings and specifications
Conduct tests on welds to ensure there are no leaks in the pressurised systems
Conduct quality checks on completed work to ensure it meets standard specifications
Apply post-weld treatments to relieve stress and enhance the strength of the welded joints on pressure-containing equipment
Diagnose faults and perform operational maintenance on machines and equipment in order to restore full functionality and safety performance, maintaining a condition that does not compromise safety
Maintain tools and equipment to a professional standard
Keep the workstation clean and orderly to retain a safe and operational work environment
Clean and prepare metal surfaces for welding by flame cutting, heat cutting, gouging, bevelling, grinding or filing
Manage workflow, meet deadlines, and troubleshoot problems on a daily basis, in addition to fabrication duties

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade qualified
Minimum of three years of experience in this role or similar
Ability to work independently and in a team environment to complete large and complex projects
Critical thinking
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Precision skills
Strong communication and reporting skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Safety focus
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!

Salary: $49.00/hour, 38 hours per week + Super

Practice Nurse — Part Time, Pennant Hills NSW 

 We are a busy, friendly private general practice seeking a skilled and motivated Practice Nurse to join our clinical team part time. This role suits a registered nurse with recent general practice or primary care experience who holds Australian general registration and is eligible to work in Australia. Our clinic values high quality patient care, collaboration, and flexible scheduling, and offers a supportive environment for ongoing learning. 

About the role

 You will deliver routine and preventive nursing care in a supportive general practice setting. Core duties include triage and assessment, wound care, immunisations, chronic disease support, clinical documentation, and assisting GPs with procedures. You will apply clinical judgment to manage patient flow, provide education, perform point of care testing, and coordinate follow up. The role is part time with an hourly rate between $40 and $50 and a flexible start timeframe to suit successful candidates. 

Key responsibilities

 
	 Conduct nursing assessments, triage and point of care testing to support timely clinical decisions. 
	 Administer vaccinations and maintain accurate immunisation records and recall systems. 
	 Provide chronic disease monitoring 
   Apply Now

result.description:
Supagas is a leading supplier of LPG, industrial, medical, specialty and helium gases in Australia. They are a fast-growing nation-wide company and are rapidly building a reputation for growth and success based on an exceptional ‘YES WE CAN’ customer service offering and quality product in the highly competitive market.

They are seeking experienced Bulk Delivery Drivers to join their team. Location: Australia-wide.

The Role:
The primary purpose of this role is to promote and Foster the “Yes We Can” attitude with both internal and external customers and representing Supagas in a positive and professional manner, to comply with all safety and regulatory requirements regarding the Transport of Dangerous Goods, securing a load, and other road rules relevant to the vehicle being driven.

Task List:
Follow correct procedures and be an example to fellow workers
Check daily that vehicle is roadworthy, equipped with all necessary safety equipment and is clean.
Make sure the truck is serviced as per the manufacturer’s requirements and Supagas procedures.
Make sure that the tanker is filled with sufficient amounts of LPG to cover all daily deliveries
Make sure all daily documentation, including but not limited to all delivery docket and manifests, is completed fully and correctly, all counts completed and checked, and all paperwork, cheques and cash handed in every day.
Deliver all orders and milk runs on the allocated daily run
Communicate all issues and non-deliveries immediately to the Logistics team
Respect all customer’s property and requirements.
Assist the company to educate our customers and make sure all customers handle and store gas appropriately and safely.
Carry out any housekeeping to maintain a safe workplace on and off the road.
Immediately report any factors which create an unsafe site for bulk deliveries to the Logistics Manager for follow up and also prior to delivery if known.
Assist the company to make sure maximum utilisation of company assets and protection of those assets.
Before every fill check test dates of cylinders and report out of date cylinders to the Logistics team.
Check Compliance Plates for all fixed Installations prior to refill and report non-compliant sites to the Logistics team.
Support the sales team and build the area by referring potential customers.
Make sure personal compliance with regulations regarding Dangerous Goods Licences.
Make sure you have the correct and adequate drivers licence for bulk delivery transportation.
Immediate reporting of any vehicle or property damage (no matter how small or large) to Logistics Manager.
Other general duties as assigned and required.
Promoting the benefits of Supagas & Supagas products
Work in a team environment and work together to maximise the productivity of the team.
Maintain safety, tidiness and housekeeping throughout entire office.
Report any hazards or problems immediately to your Supervisor at all times.

If you wish to apply for this position please submit updated resume
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super
result.title: Bulk Delivery Driver

Work location: Tamworth NSW

Duties include but will not be limited to:
Monitors and maintains the health and welfare of livestock
Assists with breeding and raising livestock
Monitors livestock to evaluate the effectiveness of feed formulae, and assists with the management of livestock nutrition and feeding programs
Provide food, water, and a clean-living environment for animals, which includes cleaning cages and enclosures
Observe animals for any signs of illness or distress, monitor their behavior, and report concerns to veterinary or research staff
Assists in controlled breeding experiments to develop improved livestock strains
Administer prescribed medications and treatments, and assist veterinarians with medical procedures in strict compliance to Newco Farm’s guidelines including completion of all relevant reports and documentation. Such paperwork to be completed within the required timeframes
Artificially inseminates livestock for breeding purposes, conducts pregnancy tests, manages lactation, and cares for young animals
Collects and collates data for research purposes
Maintain detailed and accurate records of animal care, health, treatments, and procedures performed
Ensure animal housing areas and equipment are clean, sterile, and in good working order

Safely handle and restrain animals for procedures, transportation, or other tasks

Report workplace hazards identified during the course of work to appropriate person according to standard operating procedures
Assist in the development and maintenance of Safe Work Practises. Support and implement the Company's Accident Prevention Program - support employees/work groups to ensure area is incident/accident free

Skills and knowledge
Proficiency in techniques for safely handling and restraining animals is essential
Ability to interpret animal behavior and a strong understanding of animal welfare principles are crucial
Knowledge of animal health, common diseases, and proper sanitation and hygiene practices is necessary
Organisational skills and familiarity with relevant software for record-keeping are important for maintaining accurate data
Strong communication skills are vital for working effectively with colleagues and supervisors
Technical skills on administering medication, performing basic lab techniques, or using specific farm equipment
Familiarity with regulations governing animal care is required

If you are ready to contribute to a positive and collaborative work environment, and feels this job could be the perfect opportunity for you, please apply now.
Salary: $100,000 per annum

Job Advertisement – Full-Time Engineering Technologist
Engineering Technologist (Full-Time)
Westside Blinds and Shutters Pty Ltd
Salary: $80K to $100K per annum plus superannuation
Address: 16 Callistemon Dr, Margaret River WA 6285

Westside Blinds and Shutters Pty Ltd is a well-established Australian company specialising in the supply, manufacture, installation and maintenance of high-quality blinds, shutters, awnings and custom window furnishing solutions for residential and commercial clients.

We are seeking a motivated and experienced Engineering Technologist to join our growing team on a full-time basis. The successful applicant will play a key role in improving manufacturing processes, supporting product development, implementing quality assurance systems and providing technical expertise to enhance operational efficiency.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

•	Analyse existing manufacturing and installation processes and recommend engineering solutions to improve productivity, efficiency and product quality.
•	Develop, evaluate and implement production methods, workflows and technical procedures for the manufacture and installation of blinds, shutters and customised window furnishing systems.
•	Prepare and interpret technical drawings, specifications, engineering documentation and production instructions using relevant design software.
•	Assist in the development, testing and refinement of new products, components and installation systems to meet customer and industry requirements.
•	Evaluate materials, hardware and manufacturing techniques to optimise product performance, durability and cost-effectiveness.
•	Investigate production issues, identify root causes and recommend practical engineering solutions to minimise downtime and improve operational performance.
•	Monitor production quality and implement quality assurance procedures to ensure products comply with Australian standards, company specifications and customer expectations.
•	Coordinate with production staff, installers, suppliers and management to ensure engineering requirements are effectively integrated into manufacturing and installation operations.
•	Conduct technical assessments of custom projects and provide engineering support for complex installations.
•	Assist in planning equipment upgrades, production improvements and preventative maintenance programs to maximise manufacturing efficiency.
•	Prepare technical reports, engineering calculations, process documentation and performance analyses for management review.
•	Ensure engineering activities comply with relevant workplace health and safety requirements and applicable industry regulations.

Skills and Experience

•	Relevant qualifications
•	At least 2-3 years’ experience in engineering technology, manufacturing operations or production engineering is highly regarded.
•	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and implement process improvements.
•	Experience interpreting engineering drawings and technical specifications.
•	Knowledge of manufacturing processes, quality systems and production planning.
•	Excellent communication and organisational skills with the ability to work collaboratively across multiple teams.
•	Proficiency in relevant engineering and design software will be advantageous.

If you are passionate about engineering innovation and continuous improvement and are looking to contribute to a growing manufacturing business, we encourage you to apply.
